# Manish Bisht

> Staff Engineer with a decade across product, platform, and engineering
> leadership — from founding Run4Offers to leading teams at VideoVerse. Works
> backwards from the customer problem, ships the smallest thing that solves it,
> and builds the engineering rigour to make it last. Currently applying that to
> AI-assisted products and workflows. Based in India (IST).

Personal portfolio at https://manishbisht.me. Static React single-page app on
GitHub Pages. Content is rendered client-side, so this file is the reliable
text summary if you are not executing JavaScript.

## Home page sections

The home page is one scrolling layout. These are in-page anchors, not routes.

- [Consulting](https://manishbisht.me/#consulting): engagements and services —
  senior frontend architecture, backend and platform work, applied-AI
  integration, developer productivity. Selective, 1–2 clients at a time,
  available Q3 2026, replies within 24h.
- [Experience](https://manishbisht.me/#experience): career timeline across
  media, ticketing, fintech, SaaS, and developer platforms — VideoVerse,
  BookMyShow, Let's Dive, Covalent Capital, Run4Offers.
- [Open Source](https://manishbisht.me/#open-source): Google Summer of Code
  2017 on phpMyAdmin core, and a 2018 Facebook Open Source mentorship
  contributing to Facebook Instant Articles.
- [Skills](https://manishbisht.me/#skills): AI-assisted engineering, languages
  and frameworks, frontend systems, platform and reliability, cloud and
  infrastructure, delivery and quality, engineering standards, observability,
  data and tooling.
- [Contact](https://manishbisht.me/#contact): email and social links.
